chunks.text: SHRIRAM CREDIT — LAMF Repayment Tenure Customer question: What is the repayment tenure for LAMF? Simple answer: At launch, the LAMF repayment tenure is 12 months only. Customer question: What loan tenure options are available? Simple answer: Currently, only a 12-month repayment tenure is available for LAMF. The tenure is confirmed at sanction and shown in your Key Fact Statement (KFS) and loan agreement. Customer question: Can I choose 6, 18, 24, or 36 months tenure? Simple answer: No. At this stage, LAMF is offered with a fixed 12-month repayment tenure only. Customer question: How does repayment work over the 12-month tenure? Simple answer: LAMF uses balloon repayment — you pay monthly interest during the 12-month tenure, and the full principal is due at the end of the tenure. Your exact schedule is shown in your KFS and loan agreement.
